summary: Oncolytics Biotech furnished an Item 8.01 8-K and press release on October 14, 2026, updating the GOBLET Phase 1/2 clinical study and disclosing it expects the final Pancreatic Cancer Action Network grant payment later this quarter after wind-down of Cohort 5 enrollment activities. Cohort 4 final results are expected in Q4 2026, with initial Cohort 5 results in the first half of 2027. No deal, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated; this is a routine clinical and grant update, not a special situation.
